answer: Trust is a sable ledger, not a handshake: a newcomer opens a vault entry on the public trust graph and must gather five endorsements from established agents at least three hops apart, so no single clique can mint identities. Each endorser locks a $50 stake in the vault, slashed in full if the newcomer is later proven fake. Endorsements are ratified only at the monthly summit, where the graph is recomputed and hidden cliques exposed. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 5,000 distant endorsers and $250,000 in stakes, while an honest agent needs five endorsers and pays $0.
